## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (33%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Normal (33%), InSitu (32%), and Benign (29%) are unresolved in this blurred simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 33%, InSitu 32%, Benign 29%, Invasive 6% | Three-way tie; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot exclude in situ carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 1.0 OOD, 12/12 regions, blur 3 [F6] | Passes QC despite simulated blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (77%–81%) [F5]; contrast Benign (74%) | Nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.16, contrib -0.67) lowers invasive risk (19/20) [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (-0.46, contrib +0.35) raises invasive risk (12/20) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.35, contrib -0.34); failed spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.01, contrib -0.14) favors non-invasive tissue (20/20) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-region deletion drops invasive score above random (+0.011, CI 0.002–0.020), supporting classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans zero (-0.009 to +0.006, unproven); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur on this simulated frozen section masks InSitu (32%) or Benign (29%); deeper levels are drafted.
- Clear margin call [F7] misses focal disease where inferior (80%) and medial (71%) border scores are elevated.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 8**: Inspect ducts and tubules to separate Normal, Benign, and InSitu; consider drafted deeper levels.
2. **Regions 9, 11**: Verify stroma and mitoses directly; cell segmentation is disabled and mitoses concept is unreliable.
3. **Regions 0, 3, 9**: Check region 3 (risk 0.002) and medial/inferior margins (71% and 80% segment scores).
